Protester's lookalike causes confusion during demonstration

During a protest at Jantar Mantar, a woman resembling AISA National President Neha Bora was mistakenly apprehended by police who believed her to be Bora. The confusion arose because the woman was a lookalike of Neha Bora, who was also present and protesting. The incident occurred during a demonstration demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
